summary.en: The light terminal of a narrated explainer: a white window in a hard ink frame, a line typed after the prompt sign, a log coloured by who wrote each line.
summary.zh: 解说片里的浅色终端：硬墨框白窗，提示符后打一行字，日志按谁写的上色。

fits: A question asked of a machine; a log of what an agent did; a person typing a reply.
notFor: Code walkthroughs with many lines; dark terminals (use terminal-window).

intent.en: Show that a machine was asked and answered, in a window light enough to sit on the paper with the rest of the story.
intent.zh: 交代机器被问到、给了回答，窗口够浅，和其余故事一起放在纸面上。

content.en: A title (≤ 28 chars / 14), one typed line (≤ 40 / 18), up to six log lines (≤ 40 / 18) each marked plain, ok, me or stop.
content.zh: 标题（≤ 28 字符 / 14 字）、一行输入（≤ 40 / 18）、至多 6 行日志（≤ 40 / 18），各标 plain、ok、me 或 stop。

fits.zh: 向机器提的问题；agent 做过什么的日志；人打字回复。

notFor.zh: 多行代码讲解；暗色终端（用 terminal-window）。

pairs.note: the window the counts grow in
shrinks it into a wall of windows

en: Grey is the machine, green a pass, vermilion only what a person types.
Keep the window inside x 360–1560 so the reserve stays empty.
zh: 灰色是机器，绿色是通过，朱红只给人打的字。
窗口保持在 x 360–1560 内，让出预留区。

overlaps.note: a dark keynote terminal with a block caret and a command; here a light window on paper with a coloured log and a hard shadow

waive.all: an own brick split from terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
